title: The Hall of Clocks
text: A hall of a thousand clocks rises from the floor to the high dark ceiling, each telling a different time at its own pace. The noise is like rain. One of them, small and black, ticks backward, and your own heartbeat seems to follow it.

options.label: Wind the backward clock forward, and set time right again.

outcomes.text: Time catches up all at once, carrying you a long way ahead.
Time catches up with you. It has been waiting, and it is not gentle.

options.label: The wisest listens to the ticking, and tries to learn what it counts.

outcomes.text: All thousand clocks are counting down to the same thing, and it is not far off.

options.label: Smash them all, and end the ticking for good.

outcomes.text: At last there is silence. Something was waiting for it.
